question: Which hook text look should we test against the current one?
context:
Your brand font (Bebas Neue / Anton) vs the Instagram-native serif your two biggest reels (331k, 161k) used. Big fight pages mostly use bold condensed caps; native text may be part of why your listicles went viral. Only a test settles it.

1 is the current look. Your pick runs on every other reel until both have 6+ reels with numbers; the better one becomes the default.
